verification.notes: Corrects an attribution-only true rating, not a finding that the genocide allegation is false. Live search identified a UN commission's genocide finding and official Spanish statements about Israeli measures, but repeated attempts to retrieve those primary pages failed. The full compound assertion, including the unspecified alleged campaign against Spain and motive, was not independently resolved in this review.
